title: ModuleTaskWorkerService
responsibility: Claim and run module tasks with a trusted sealed CLI context and exact role-specific files, preserving attempts/reviews/model/usage and cleaning process context before finalization.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.once.worker
inputs.description: Worker id. Must match ^[a-z0-9]+(?:[.-][a-z0-9]+)*$; invalid values throw before owner lookup or task mutation.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.once.modules
inputs.description: Optional exact module-id allowlist. Defaults to []; an empty array permits any eligible module. Values are matched exactly and are not independently validated or normalized.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.once.signal
inputs.description: Optional cancellation signal. Already-aborted signals reject before owner/queue access; active execution is awaited before context cleanup.

inputs.name: pendingTaskResult.selection
inputs.description: Selected provider, model and intelligence recorded on the initial pending result.

inputs.name: pendingTaskResult.worktree
inputs.description: Worktree path recorded on the initial pending result.

inputs.name: claimedTask.queue
inputs.description: Mutable queue clone supplied by ModuleTaskRepository.update.

inputs.name: claimedTask.worker
inputs.description: Worker id compared against optional task assignee and stored in the claim.

inputs.name: claimedTask.modules
inputs.description: Exact module-id allowlist; empty permits any module.

inputs.name: claimedTask.owner
inputs.description: Current clone owner from ModuleTaskRepository.owner: workspace UUID, positive process id and process start-time text.

inputs.name: finishTask.queue
inputs.description: Mutable queue clone to receive the result if the original running claim and task definition still match.

inputs.name: finishTask.claimed
inputs.description: Task record returned by the claim update; its id, claim token, contractHash, sourceCommit and repairCommit are compared with the current queue record.

inputs.name: finishTask.result
inputs.description: Result to persist. A truthy error selects failed; no error or an empty error string selects review.

inputs.name: taskWrites.git
inputs.description: Git boundary used to inspect the worktree HEAD, tracked differences and non-ignored untracked files.

inputs.name: taskWrites.task
inputs.description: Stored task whose sourceCommit and module.files define the permitted worktree head and path allowlist.

inputs.name: TaskRunner.run.input
inputs.description: Selected provider/model/intelligence plus cwd, prompt, signal and trusted transient TaskRunScope. Exact files come from prepare; scope is passed to each attempt and never stored in the queue result.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.constructor.contexts
inputs.type: optional Pick<ModuleTaskContractContextService,"create">; default real context service at root

inputs.name: claimedTask.prepare
inputs.description: Pure callback receives the selected task and accepted same-feature checkpoint IDs copied atomically from the queue before claiming.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.constructor.dependencyBase
inputs.description: Trusted fourth collaborator; default composes committed accepted checkpoints.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.onceApproved.worker
inputs.description: Worker id subject to the same validation as once.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.onceApproved.scope
inputs.description: Trusted server-verified approved plan, feature, and exact prepared task definitions; copied before asynchronous work.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.onceApproved.signal
inputs.description: Optional cancellation signal with the same behavior as once.

inputs.name: TaskRunner.ready
inputs.description: Trusted in-process runner readiness callback. The default runner checks isolation qualification. Injected host or test runners may omit it.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.once
outputs.description: Checks optional runner readiness before owner lookup or task claim and rechecks cancellation after it resolves. The default unqualified runner rejects without a queue update. Uses ModuleTaskService.prepare(task).files/role, creates detached worktree from selected repairCommit??sourceCommit, obtains contexts.create(task with selected sourceCommit,worktree,exact prepared files), passes scope to every run including quota-only fallback. Waits owned runner settlement before context.cleanup; cleanup awaited on success/failure/cancel/context-safe errors. No scope/snapshot/bin paths leaked into committed result. Post-diff/checkpoint uses prepared exact files, never broader legacy module.files. Existing claim/finish CAS and actual usage/analytics retained; no self-acceptance. Dependent tasks compose accepted checkpoints and optional repair revision; the effective source is used for prompt, context, worktree, snapshot and result while the original queued task identity remains unchanged.

outputs.name: pendingTaskResult
outputs.description: Builds an initial result from selection and worktree with reportedModel null, empty text, empty changedFiles and executions arrays, fallback false, and finishedAt set to the current ISO timestamp. It does not persist the result.

outputs.name: claimedTask
outputs.description: Selects the first queued task eligible for the worker and module, with every named dependency present and accepted, no running task in the same module, and no overlapping exact frozen file grant with another running task. Blocked candidates remain queued while later independent candidates can run. Invokes optional preparation before changing status; on success records the running claim with worker, random token, time and owner. Every dependency must have an accepted same-feature result with a valid checkpoint; the preparation callback receives the captured checkpoint list.

outputs.name: finishTask
outputs.description: Finds the current task by claimed.id and throws if it is absent, is not running, has a different optional claim token, contractHash, sourceCommit or repairCommit. On a match it sets status to failed for a truthy result.error or review otherwise, then stores result. It mutates only the supplied queue clone, does not commit, append attempts/claimHistory or clear the claim, and a second finalization after status leaves running is rejected.

outputs.name: taskWrites
outputs.description: First requires git rev-parse HEAD to equal task.sourceCommit, otherwise throws and leaves the worktree in place. Collects tracked changed paths from git diff --name-only -z HEAD and non-ignored untracked paths from git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z; removes empty entries and deduplicates in first-seen order. Any collected path not exactly included in task.module.files throws and reports the outside paths, with the worktree preserved. Otherwise returns all collected paths. It does not stage, commit, normalize paths or report ignored untracked files. Worker callers supply task.module.files narrowed to the exact prepared role-specific files.

outputs.name: TaskRunResult
outputs.type: TaskSelection & {text: string; reportedModel: string | null; usage?: TaskUsage}
outputs.description: Committed repository contract for TaskRunner.run. The worker later merges dispatch output into the task workspace result and records execution history.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.onceApproved
outputs.description: Checks optional runner readiness before owner lookup or task claim and rechecks cancellation after it resolves. The default unqualified runner rejects without a queue update. Atomically verify the latest matching approval and exact prepared task definitions before claiming only a task from that approved plan, while retaining all running tasks for file and module contention and accepted tasks for dependency checks. Then use the existing execution and finalization path.

errors.name: Context cannot be prepared
errors.type: failed before any provider call, no fake usage; valid claim finalized rather than stranded running

examples.expected: failed finalized claim; no runner call or fabricated provider usage; safe contract-context failure diagnostic

examples.input: runner rejects or cancellation occurs after context creation
examples.expected: wait execution settlement then cleanup exactly once; retain submission/worktree and existing failure semantics

errors.name: Cancellation
errors.type: no new claim after already-aborted signal; active process awaited then context cleaned; existing review/failed semantics retained

errors.name: Outside prepared grant
errors.type: reject checkpoint/submission, keep worktree for review

errors.name: ModuleTaskRepository queue data validation
errors.description: Per the committed repository contract, invalid stored queue data fails schema parsing and malformed queue.json fails JSON parsing. Repository Git, filesystem, callback and 16-attempt CAS exhaustion errors also propagate from claim or finish updates.

errors.name: Workspace preparation failure after claim
errors.type: failed finalized result; worktree empty string and no provider usage
errors.description: If taskWorkspace rejects, finalize the valid claim as failed with a safe nonempty error, worktree:"", changedFiles:[], no usage/executions, and no snapshot of an unavailable worktree. The stored result schema explicitly accepts empty worktree; never invent an artifact path.

errors.name: Dependency missing or composition failure
errors.description: Missing/unaccepted/cross-feature/invalid dependency checkpoints are not claimed; composition errors never call context or provider and do not invent usage.

errors.name: Approval scope changed
errors.description: Reject before queue mutation or provider execution if the plan, approval, feature or admitted task definitions no longer match the committed queue.

errors.name: Unqualified runner
errors.type: safe prelaunch Error before queue mutation or provider launch
errors.description: A rejected readiness check leaves queued work and its attempt history unchanged; no provider is called.
